liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Me and My Uncle** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer praises the pedal steel playing here too; Cassette has no gap between it and Silver Threads; Jerry apparently switched between pedal steel and electric guitar [1][10]
- **Dancin' in the Streets** (2 reviews): Reviewer says this performance drew praise in the New York press; Vocals begin at about 4:48, after a long instrumental opening [6][7]
- **Silver Threads and Golden Needles** (1 review): Reviewer praises the pedal steel playing [10]
- **Casey Jones** (1 review): Jams for many more minutes than the usual studio-style version [6]

## Setlist highlights

- Earliest performances in the archive: Casey Jones, Casey Jones [16]

## The recordings

- **gd69-06-22.aud.hanno.8836.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 13 songs; 108 min; rated 2.38/5 by 8 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience tape captures very loud obscenities from people nearby; Audience tape is muddy and hissy, but the jams come through; it is the only complete version; Audience recording is noisy and requires patience to listen through [10][13][15]
- **gd69-06-22.sbd.kaplan.17892.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 2 songs; 23 min; rated 2.33/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: Soundboard portion is the good part; the rest of the show survives only as a poor, incomplete audience tape; Reviewer finds the soundboard recording unusable [6][9]
- **gd1969-06-22.164056.sbd.remaster.daniel.flac16**: soundboard; 3 songs; 22 min [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer jokes that Owsley Stanley dosed the coffee before the Central Park show [8]
- Reviewer recalls a hot day, with people handing out strong Owsley acid in the crowd [12]
- Reviewer describes it as a free concert [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-06-22.aud.hanno.8836.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Julian, Uli,  H.B.; source: Audience patched with Soundboard (Whole Show) [1]. Also: Audience source comes from a cassette; songs were reordered to follow Jim Powell's Deadlists order [1]
- **gd69-06-22.sbd.kaplan.17892.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Seth Kaplan; source: Soundboard (Partial Show) [2]. Also: Only 22½ minutes of the soundboard circulate: Dancin' in the Streets and Casey Jones; Transfer was pitch-raised by a half step plus 5 cents in Cool Edit 2000, with a bass cut [2]
- **gd1969-06-22.164056.sbd.remaster.daniel.flac16**: transferred by Mastered by Daniel  March 19th, 2023; source: This is a speed-corrected remaster of shnid 8836 [3]. Also: Speed-corrected remaster of shnid 8836, with azimuth adjusted and low-end hum reduced; Source was put into circulation by Hanno Bunjes and Julian [3]
